admission.justification: Future changes to host intake, task projection or task-status consumers must preserve this bounded authority: duplicate task truth, unsupported paused observations, reconstructed membership or conflicting status/age presentation produce incorrect task operations. The named current source assertions guard the specified facets; this is no fresh Curator execution grade.

applicability: The single server TaskEntry/taskCounts wire surface and qualified browser tasks map.
conditions: The native producer joins authored summaries, bound host observations and independently bound worktrees before consumers receive entries.
Task-owned identity, stage/activity, progress and ordered child membership are not duplicated into the optional summary.

Live provider limit facts join TaskEntry.providerLimit; attention, analytics, landing-operation and unbound-enclosure facts retain independent surfaces, not another task collection. Retired CGC/GrepAI provider state supplies no dashboard surface.
exclusions: On-demand task document resources and their body/revision caches are content, not a second task-stage collection.
No claim that independent operational records are removed, nor that every raw input is read on every watcher wake.
